_comment: AVX broker + executor policy defaults — seeded into SSM Parameter Store at 'cdk deploy vsa-{stage}-avx-*'. All values are user-tunable via the future admin configurator; no code change required to adjust them. Keys use the literal '{stage}' template token; seeding substitutes the actual stage name.
_addenda: D3 (APNs threshold + rate-limit + cardinality-cap) and D5 (retry-policy + escalation). See spec.md § 'Config-driven policy (Addenda D3, D5)' and § 'Retry count + escalation target — proposal'.

parameters.description: Minimum Finding severity that triggers an APNs push. Sub-threshold findings create an in-app card only. Addendum D3, assumption-flagged pending user confirmation.
parameters._note_d3: Assumption: P0-only is the right threshold. Flagged in decisions.md § '2026-09-18 — D3 assumption flagged'. This value is NOT provisional — it is the spec-stated default. The assumption itself (P0 only fires APNs) is what is flagged for user confirmation.

parameters.description: Per-owner card creation caps. 'day' is a rolling 24-hour window; 'hour' is a rolling 60-minute window. Excess requests are rejected at the broker before card creation.
Per-owner per-day ceiling on total open cards (across all Findings + Actions). Excess is truncated by lowest priority + oldest first.

Per-target retry count and exponential backoff window for transient failures (5xx, network, timeout). Terminal 4xx failures are never retried — they transition directly to Action.status=declined. On retry-budget exhaustion, Action.status=failed.
parameters._CONFIRMED: 2026-09-18 — user-confirmed per spec.md § 'Retry count + escalation target — CONFIRMED 2026-09-18 (SNS topic choice still open)'. Replaces a stale _PROVISIONAL marker that claimed these were a coder proposal pending sign-off, and cited that section by its pre-confirmation name. The SNS topic choice remains open; the retry/backoff values below do not.
parameters._rationale: retry_count=3 (initial + 2 retries), backoff_base_ms=1000, backoff_cap_ms=4000 gives a worst-case wall clock of ~6s, safely under API Gateway's 29s timeout so the approve route can remain synchronous.

parameters.description: Escalation configuration fired when Action.status transitions to 'failed' (retry budget exhausted). Dual escalation: owner-visible synthetic iOS card + operator-visible EventBridge + CloudWatch metric.
parameters._CONFIRMED: 2026-09-18 — retry policy and dual-escalation shape confirmed by the user; dedicated SNS topic confirmed (NOT the shared Tier 2 alarm topic). See decisions.md § '2026-09-18 — User confirmations: D5 retry policy and dual escalation' and § '2026-09-18 — User confirmation (c)'. No longer provisional.
parameters._note_subscription: Group 7 acceptance criterion, not a follow-up: the topic MUST have a subscription with a real endpoint and an observed delivery. Publishing into an unsubscribed topic records the failure and tells no human — that is the CMS VFO failure mode (100% failure for 14+ days, empty AlarmActions, nobody paged). Created / published-to / delivered-and-observed are three separate claims.
parameters._note_d5: Addendum D5. 'failed' and 'declined' are distinct terminal states. 'declined' = target refused (4xx, no retry, no escalation). 'failed' = executor exhausted retries, fires this escalation config.

parameters.description: FI cost agent (agent-fi-cost, component cost): the most vehicles one daily run diagnoses with a model call, counted after unchanged vehicles are skipped. Vehicles past it wait for the next daily run, in excess-cost order, and are counted as 'deferred' in the run record. One diagnosis is at most two Converse calls (one retry). Integer 0..500; an absent or malformed value falls back to the built-in default 50.
parameters._source: Spec 2026-10-02-fi-cost-stage-b U5 / D11 (default 50, about $0.90 a full run at Sonnet 4.6 list price); decisions.md 2026-10-05 item 6 (the cap counts model calls after the unchanged-skip, not the selection query). Read by agents/tier2/runner.resolve_max_diagnoses_per_run; a one-run override is the event field max_diagnoses_per_run (task 5.3 item 2).

parameters.description: FI rebalancing agent (agent-fi-rebalancing, component rebalance): its U9 thresholds. target_utilization: a source stays at or under this forecast utilisation after its moves. deficit_above: forecast utilisation above this is a deficit day. max_utilization: the most of a vehicle's operating hours that can be on rent. min_net_benefit_usd: move candidates under this are dropped. max_vehicles_per_move: the most vehicles one move names. Exactly these keys; no default exists in code, so an absent or malformed value aborts the run before any write.
parameters._source: Spec 2026-10-06-fi-rebalancing-stage-e U9 (approved 2026-10-06): target 85%, deficit above 90%, at most 95% achievable, at most 10 vehicles a move. At least $100 net benefit a move, as U9 names: the agent used $50 from task 4.1c until the user approved U9's $100 for Group 6 (decisions.md 2026-10-16). deficit_above and target_utilization must equal ADP's fleet_bookings_parameters row (parameters.yaml), which ADP's supply_demand_gaps view applies; surplus_below (70%) is applied only there. Read by agents/fi_rebalancing/policy.load_from_ssm. The auto-approval bounds (U6) are their own parameter below (Group 8, task 8.3), because this one's loader requires exactly its own keys.

parameters.description: Auto-approval bounds for limited action kinds (move_vehicles, U6). max_limit_usd: the largest limit any rule may carry; a rule approves a move only when the move's transfer_cost_usd is at or under the rule's limit. max_vehicles_per_auto_move: the most vehicles one rule-approved move may name. Exactly these keys. Read at run time by the approval-rules API (validates a rule's limit), the auto-approver (approves only within them) and CMS's internal move route (re-checks them); an absent, unreadable or malformed value fails closed in all three.
parameters._source: Spec 2026-10-06-fi-rebalancing-stage-e U6 (approved 2026-10-06): a transfer-cost limit bounded at $500, at most 5 vehicles. Parsed by agents/executors/policy.parse_auto_approval_bounds (AVX) and services/fleet_intelligence/moves.parse_auto_approval_bounds (CMS); group8-notes G8-D5.
